import torch
import torch.nn as nn

class DL_Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super(DL_Model, self).__init__()

        # Define the specialized block for each branch
        self.branch1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels=1, out_channels=32, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(num_features=32),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(p=0.5),
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels=32, out_channels=64, kernel_size=1, stride=1, padding=0),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(num_features=64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(p=0.5)
        )

        self.branch2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels=1, out_channels=32, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(num_features=32),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(p=0.5),
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels=32, out_channels=64, kernel_size=1, stride=1, padding=0),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(num_features=64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(p=0.5)
        )

        self.branch3 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels=1, out_channels=32, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(num_features=32),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(p=0.5),
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels=32, out_channels=64, kernel_size=1, stride=1, padding=0),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(num_features=64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(p=0.5)
        )

        # Concatenate the outputs of the three branches
        self.concat = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels=192, out_channels=128, kernel_size=1, stride=1, padding=0),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(num_features=128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(p=0.5)
        )

        # Fully connected layers for classification
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(in_features=128 * 28 * 28, out_features=512)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(in_features=512, out_features=10)

    def forward(self, x):
        # Process each branch
        out1 = self.branch1(x)
        out2 = self.branch2(x)
        out3 = self.branch3(x)

        # Concatenate the outputs
        out = torch.cat((out1, out2, out3), dim=1)

        # Process the concatenated output
        out = self.concat(out)

        # Flatten the output for the fully connected layers
        out = out.view(out.size(0), -1)

        # Apply the fully connected layers
        out = self.fc1(out)
        out = self.fc2(out)

        return out
